sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII — Sound Transmission Control Standards
sources.description: Governs sound transmission requirements between dwelling units in multi-family buildings and between occupancy types.

sources.label: ASTM E413 — Classification for Rating Sound Insulation (STC Classification)
sources.description: Standard for Sound Transmission Class (STC) ratings. Defines STC 50+ as typical requirement for party walls between dwelling units.

sources.label: ASTM E90 — Standard Test Method for Laboratory Measurement of Airborne Sound Transmission
sources.description: Standard test method for measuring airborne sound transmission loss of building partitions. Used to verify STC ratings.
